징집.englishDescription: An act of drafting people with military duty for military service.

쫄쫄.englishDescription: In the state of being very hungry.

찔끔거리다.englishDescription: For liquid, etc., to seep or ooze out in small quantities, or make something become that way.

창구멍.englishDescription: A hole made to put in a window.

천연색.englishDescription: The color of something in its natural state.

천재.definitionKo: 태어날 때부터 남들보다 뛰어난 재주나 재능을 가진 사람.

철렁.englishDescription: In the manner of worrying or feeling heavy due to being greatly surprised by something.

철벅철벅.definitionKo: 얕은 물이나 진흙탕을 자꾸 거칠게 밟거나 치는 소리. 또는 그 모양.

카운터.englishDescription: A small, metal or plastic piece, which is temporarily used in a card game, etc., instead of cash.

평균대.englishDescription: A long and narrow wooden bar set like a bridge, being used for gymnastics.

평균대.definitionKo: 길고 좁은 나무를 다리처럼 놓은 기구를 이용한 여자 체조 경기 종목.
평균대.englishDescription: One of women's gymnastics competitions that uses a long and narrow wooden bar set like a bridge.

평절.definitionKo: 인사를 드릴 때나 특별한 일이 없는 보통 때에 하는 절.
평절.englishDescription: A bow performed when greeting someone, or under an ordinary situation of no special importance.

표면.definitionKo: 사물의 가장 바깥쪽. 또는 가장 윗부분.
표면.englishDescription: The outermost side or top of an object.
A part of something that is exposed or visible.

풍자.definitionKo: 남의 부족한 점을 다른 것에 빗대어 비웃으면서 폭로하고 공격함.
풍자.englishDescription: An act of making fun of, disclosing, and attacking someone's weakness by comparing it to another thing.

풍자.definitionKo: 문학 작품 등에서, 현실의 바람직하지 못한 점이나 이치에 맞지 않는 일 등을 빗대어 비웃으면서 씀.
풍자.englishDescription: In a literary or other work, an act of satirizing and making fun of an undesirable aspect of reality or an unjustifiable incident, etc., by writing about it with comparison to others.

피륙.definitionKo: 아직 자르지 않은 베, 무명, 비단 등의 천.
피륙.englishDescription: An uncut cloth such as hemp, cotton, silk, etc.

피서지.englishDescription: A cool place where one can get away from the summer heat.

하루가 여삼추(라).definitionKo: 짧은 시간이 매우 길게 느껴진다는 말.
하루가 여삼추(라).englishDescription: An expression used to describe a situation where one feels as if a short time is very long.
하루가 여삼추(라).englishExpression: One day feels as if three autumns

하여튼.englishDescription: Regardless of how something turns out.

하치장.englishDescription: A site for dumping and disposing of rubbish.

하치장.definitionKo: 자동차나 기차 등으로 싣고 온 짐 등을 내려놓는 곳.
하치장.englishDescription: A place for unloading the freight carried by a car or train, etc.

하편.definitionKo: 상하, 또는 상중하로 나뉜 책이나 글의 끝 편.
하편.englishDescription: The last book out of a collection of two or three books.
하편.englishExpression: second volume; volume two; third volume; last volume

하행.englishDescription: An act of going to a lower destination.

하행.definitionKo: 서울에서 지방으로 내려감. 또는 그런 기차나 버스 등의 교통수단.
하행.englishDescription: An act of departing from Seoul, going to other regions of Korea, or such a means of transportation, such as a train, bus, etc.
하행.englishExpression: downward-bound train; line bound away from Seoul

학사모.englishDescription: A hat worn at university graduation ceremonies.

한집.englishDescription: A family living together in the same house.

한집.definitionKo: 부모와 자식, 형제 등 같은 핏줄로 이루어진 집안.
한집.englishDescription: A family formed by parents, children, siblings, etc., who are related by blood.

한탕 치다.definitionKo: 부정행위나 범죄 행위 같은 못된 짓을 한바탕 무분별하게 저지르다.
한탕 치다.englishDescription: To commit a bout of misdeeds such as pranks or crimes in an indiscriminate manner.

해당하다.definitionKo: 어떤 범위나 조건 등에 바로 들어맞다.
해당하다.englishDescription: To fit right into a certain range or condition, etc.
해당하다.englishExpression: correspond to; be equivalent to; be tantamount to

해부.definitionKo: 생물체의 한 부분 또는 전부를 갈라 그 내부를 조사함.
해부.englishDescription: An act of cutting the whole or one part of an organism open and examining the inside of it.

해부.definitionKo: 사물의 상태를 자세히 분석하고 그 구조와 내용에 대해 연구함.
해부.englishDescription: An act of examining the state of an object closely and studying its structure and contents.

해소되다.definitionKo: 어려운 일이나 좋지 않은 상태가 해결되어 없어지다.
해소되다.englishDescription: For a difficult problem or unfavorable situation to be addressed and disappear.
해소되다.englishExpression: be resolved; be relieved; be eased; be released

해소되다.englishDescription: For a certain group or organization to disappear.

해수욕하다.englishDescription: To swim and play in the sea water.

해조.definitionKo: 미역, 김, 다시마 등과 같이 바다에서 나며 홀씨로 번식하는 식물.
해조.englishDescription: Plants that grow in the sea and reproduce by seeds, such as seaweed, laver, and kelp.

핸드백.definitionKo: 여자들이 손에 들거나 한쪽 어깨에 메는 작은 가방.
핸드백.englishDescription: A small bag carried by a woman in one hand or over the shoulder.

행상.englishDescription: An act of going from place to place, selling goods.
A person who goes from place to place, selling goods.

허리띠.definitionKo: 바지 등이 흘러내리지 않도록 옷의 허리 부분에 둘러매는 띠.
허리띠.englishDescription: A strap worn around the waist to prevent the pants, etc., from falling down.

험준하다.englishDescription: The ground or a mountain, etc., being high and steep.

헛되이.englishDescription: In a manner of bearing no fruit or having no substance.

헛발질.englishDescription: A kick that misses the mark.

헬리콥터.definitionKo: 회전 날개를 돌려서 하늘을 나는 비행기.
헬리콥터.englishDescription: An aircraft that flies in the sky by rotating rotor blades.

협의.definitionKo: 어떤 말의 뜻을 정의할 때에, 좁은 의미.
협의.englishDescription: A narrowly defined meaning of a word.
An act of a group of people sharing opinions with each other.

호주머니를 털다.englishDescription: To give all the money in one's hands.
호주머니를 털다.englishExpression: empty one's pocket; empty one's purse to the last penny; clear one's purse out
empty someone's pocket; empty someone's purse to the last penny; clear someone's purse out

혼수상태.definitionKo: 외부의 강한 자극에 대한 반응이 나타나지 않고, 부르거나 뒤흔들어 깨워도 정신을 차리지 못할 정도로 의식을 잃은 상태.
혼수상태.englishDescription: A state in which one has lost consciousness, unable to show any response to strong, external stimulations or come to one's senses and wake up even when being called or shaken by another.

혼탁하다.definitionKo: 더러운 물질이 섞여 깨끗하지 못하고 흐리다.
혼탁하다.englishDescription: Being muddy, not clear, with a filthy substance added.

혼탁하다.definitionKo: 정치, 도덕 등의 사회 현상이 어지럽고 깨끗하지 못하다.
혼탁하다.englishDescription: A social phenomenon involving politics or morality being characterized by disorder and impurity.

홀소리.definitionKo: 사람이 목청을 울려 내는 소리로, 공기의 흐름이 방해를 받지 않고 나는 소리.
홀소리.englishDescription: A sound made by vibrating one's vocal cords without obstructing the flow of air.

홍보하다.englishDescription: To promote a product, fact, etc., widely to a certain target.

화소.definitionKo: 텔레비전이나 사진 전송에서, 화면을 구성하고 있는 면적의 최소 단위.
화소.englishDescription: In television or photographic transmission, the smallest unit of area that constitutes the screen.

화제.englishDescription: Material or content worth making into a story.

환속.englishDescription: In Buddhism, an act of quitting living as a monk and going back to a secular world.
환속.englishExpression: returning to lay life; leaving the priesthood

황혼.definitionKo: 해가 지고 조금씩 어두워지는 때. 또는 그때의 빛.
황혼.englishDescription: The time of slight darkness between the sunset and night; or the light that shines during this time.

황혼.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 사람의 생애나 나라의 운명 등이 한창인 고비를 지나 점점 약해져 마지막에 이른 상태.
황혼.englishDescription: (figurative) A state in which one's life or a country's fate weakens past its peak and reaches its end.

회전목마.definitionKo: 목마에 사람을 태우고 빙글빙글 돌아가게 만든 놀이기구.
회전목마.englishDescription: A ride for entertaining children, carrying them on wooden horses and going around.

회합.definitionKo: 의견을 나누기 위해 여러 사람이 모임. 또는 그런 모임.
회합.englishDescription: Many people meeting to share their opinions on an issue, etc.; or such a meeting.

휘몰리다.englishDescription: To be driven hard toward a certain direction.
For a storm, etc., to move or spread uncontrollably.
휘몰리다.englishExpression: be raged; be stormed; be swirled

흔연히.englishDescription: Gladly and happily in a willing manner.

흘긋흘긋하다.englishDescription: To look sideways at something furtively, repeatedly.
흘긋흘긋하다.englishExpression: keep looking sideways; keep leering at

흡족하다.definitionKo: 조금도 모자람이 없을 정도로 넉넉하여 만족하다.
흡족하다.englishDescription: Being pleased with something because it is sufficient without any shortage.

흥미진진하다.englishDescription: Arousing a great deal of interest.

흥흥하다.definitionKo: 계속 코를 세게 풀거나 콧김을 불다.
흥흥하다.englishDescription: To blow one's nose hard or breathing through the nostrils continuously.
To emit a low, droning sound continuously, out of joy or excitement.

희구하다.englishDescription: To want to do or have something.

희망의 등대.definitionKo: 앞날에 대한 희망을 주는 마음의 기둥이나 지탱점.
희망의 등대.englishDescription: A mainstay or foothold that provides hope for the future.

희생되다.definitionKo: 어떤 사람이나 목적 때문에 목숨, 재산, 명예, 이익 등이 바쳐지거나 버려지다. 또는 그것이 빼앗기게 되다.
희생되다.englishDescription: For one's life, property, reputation, interest, etc., to be given away, relinquished or taken away for the benefit of someone else or some cause.

희생되다.definitionKo: 사고나 자연 재해 등으로 슬프고 안타깝게 목숨을 잃게 되다.
희생되다.englishDescription: For one's life to be lost in a sad and pitiful manner due to an accident, natural disaster, etc.

희생하다.definitionKo: 어떤 사람이나 목적을 위해 자신의 목숨, 재산, 명예, 이익 등을 바치거나 버리다. 또는 그것을 빼앗기다.
희생하다.englishDescription: To give away or relinquish one's life, property, reputation, interest, etc., for the benefit of someone else or some cause.

힐금.definitionKo: 눈을 옆으로 돌려 슬쩍 한 번 쳐다보는 모양.
힐금.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of directing the eyes sideways and looking furtively at something for one time.
